archetypes.name: dyn-quota-gate
archetypes.rationale: The change couples quota classification, plan-disposition gating, and stall-recovery token propagation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Step 2 complete-path ordering and verify quota can only override completion after independently computed plan coverage requires disposition. Check that no commit materialization or staging can occur first, and that full-coverage quota markers remain non-blocking. Trace the quota bail token through classifier and safe-rendering surfaces. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
